design_detail: 3% of net wealth above US$100 million; also discusses billionaires above US$1 billion.
quote_original: A todas las personas del país nos beneficiaría un impuesto especial a las grandes fortunas.
quote_en: A special tax on large fortunes would benefit everyone in the country.

grading_note: The organisation explicitly endorses a tax and specifies 3% on net wealth above US$100m in the same paragraph.

design_detail: Uniform annual 3.5% on net wealth above MXN10,746m
quote_original: se tributaría el patrimonio neto de aquellas personas con una riqueza neta superior a 10,746 millones de pesos.
quote_en: The net wealth of those people with net wealth above 10,746 million pesos would be taxed.
source_title: Recomendaciones para fortalecer la justicia fiscal: Propuestas para la administración 2024-2030
grading_note: Own authored report recommends annual net wealth tax with specific rate and threshold on pp12-13; colophon p27 states first edition April 2025. URL is a later upload.

design_detail: Editorial advocates wealth taxation while discussing the global billionaire-tax proposal

quote_en: in the absence of wealth and stock-market speculation taxes, the rich have no incentive to invest for the benefit of society
source_title: Impuesto a ricos: imperativo ético y económico
grading_note: Own editorial argues for wealth taxation; the 2% design is attributed to others rather than expressly adopted by the newspaper.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax: 1% for USD5bn, 2% for USD10bn, 5% above USD15bn

quote_en: they propose a progressive wealth tax: 1% for those who own 5 billion dollars
source_title: Organización civil pide aplicar impuesto para los millonarios en México
grading_note: Contemporaneous report of the organisation’s public demonstration and specific progressive tax proposal; not inferred from coalition membership.

design_detail: Calls for wealth taxation alongside debt cancellation

source_title: Aumentar impuestos a ricos sería un avance en redistribución: Alianza contra la Desigualdad
grading_note: Her own directly quoted call names a wealth tax; no rate specified. Public advocacy in Mexico, not inferred from staff membership.

grading_note: Own advocacy and specific tax design attributed to her in contemporaneous news report. Quote is the report’s verbatim wording, not presented as her direct quotation.

quote_en: Charging more taxes on large fortunes and corporations benefits us, because we would all benefit from living in a more equal and fair Mexico.
source_title: La (ir)responsabilidad fiscal de las élites
publisher: Revista de la Universidad de México
grading_note: Máximo Ernesto Jaramillo Molina is a named co-author; the co-authored article explicitly supports higher taxes on large fortunes.

design_detail: Proposes reforming ISR so fortunes above US$1 billion contribute 8% of their wealth.
quote_original: reformar el ISR para que personas con fortunas mayores a mil millones de dólares aporten un 8% de su riqueza
quote_en: reform the income-tax law so people with fortunes above one billion dollars contribute 8% of their wealth
source_title: Los desafíos del sistema fiscal en México
publisher: Centro de Investigación Jurídica de la Universidad de los Andes
grading_note: Conference summary attributes this specific Oxfam México proposal to Alexandra Haas; it meets the annual wealth-tax definition with a threshold and rate.

design_detail: Publicly links the wealth-tax demand to labour rights and public services; no rate or threshold.
quote_original: We raise our voices for the 40-hour work week, for the wealth tax, for education and health care for all.
quote_en: We raise our voices for the 40-hour work week, for the wealth tax, for education and health care for all.
source_title: Chronicle of the ‘Rise For’ protest
grading_note: Fight Inequality Alliance’s account identifies Sara Arteaga as the speaker and attributes this explicit wealth-tax demand to her.

design_detail: Discusses an annual wealth tax covering assets and liabilities; no rate or threshold proposed by the author.

quote_en: This is precisely where the proposal for wealth taxes on the top of Mexico's social pyramid becomes relevant
source_title: Una propuesta de impuesto a la riqueza para México
grading_note: The named author presents a wealth-tax proposal as relevant to Mexico and describes it as a corrective measure. The wording is scholarly rather than a personal endorsement, so Grade C.

design_detail: Tax on individuals with high concentrations of wealth, including cars, art and mansions.
quote_original: El que la riqueza se concentre en tan pocas manos y no haya impuestos al patrimonio neto es prueba de ello
quote_en: The fact that wealth is concentrated in so few hands and that there are no taxes on net wealth is proof of this
source_title: Gravar el patrimonio de mexicanos más ricos generaría 4 mil 912 mdd
grading_note: The article identifies Emmanuel Ramírez Casillas as a Fundar researcher, explains that Fundar researchers list creating wealth taxes among the first steps, and attributes this direct critique of the absence of net-wealth taxes to him.

design_detail: Proposes considering a wealth tax; no rate or threshold.

quote_en: I would therefore propose the possibility of a wealth tax

publisher: Máximo Jaramillo / Alma Luisa Rodríguez Leal-Isla
grading_note: The report identifies Iván Benumea as a civil-society participant and records his explicit proposal for a wealth tax.

design_detail: Supports approval of a wealth tax targeting large fortunes; no rate or threshold.

quote_en: The head of Tmsourcing hopes that the fiscal reform gives the green light to the tax on large fortunes so it can be applied in the country
source_title: Aplicar un impuesto a la riqueza en México debería ser temporal: expertos
grading_note: The article identifies the quoted head of Tmsourcing as Adolfo González Olhovich and reports his hope for approval of the wealth tax.

design_detail: Tax on multimillionaire fortunes; no specified rate or threshold.

quote_en: there has to be a tax on multimillionaire fortunes; that would increase revenues and bring redistributive justice
source_title: Morenista propone gravar grandes fortunas para tener ingreso extra de 300 mmdp
grading_note: The article directly attributes the explicit wealth-tax endorsement to legislator Alejandro Rojas Díaz Durán.

design_detail: A 4.5% solidarity tax on fortunes of USD500m or more.
quote_original: el Grupo Parlamentario del Partido del Trabajo resolvió pronunciarse en favor de estas medidas proponiendo un impuesto solidario de 4.5% a las grandes fortunas, iguales o mayores a 500 millones de dólares
quote_en: the Parliamentary Group of the Labour Party resolved to support these measures, proposing a 4.5% solidarity tax on large fortunes of USD500 million or more
source_title: Segundo Informe de Actividades Legislativas con Interpelación Ciudadana
grading_note: The official legislative report directly attributes the proposed 4.5% tax on large fortunes to the PT parliamentary group. Grade A organisational position.

design_detail: A 4% tax on fortunes above MXN600m.
quote_original: consideramos necesario impulsar el impuesto de 4 % a las grandes fortunas de las 3,790 personas en México cuyas fortunas son mayores a los 600 millones de pesos
quote_en: we consider it necessary to promote a 4% tax on the large fortunes of the 3,790 people in Mexico whose fortunes exceed MXN600 million
source_title: ¡Más impuestos a los millonarios!
publisher: Organización de Lucha por la Emancipación Popular
grading_note: The organisation's own article explicitly supports a 4% tax on large fortunes above a stated threshold. Grade A organisational statement.

design_detail: Demanded that governments create a wealth tax where it did not exist, including Mexico.
quote_original: las organizaciones Alianza contra la Desigualdad México y Nuestro Presupuesto se unieron del 15 al 22 de enero a la protesta global para exigirle a los gobiernos la creación de un impuesto a la riqueza, en el caso de países donde no existe como México
quote_en: the organisations Alianza contra la Desigualdad México and Nuestro Presupuesto joined the global protest from 15 to 22 January to demand that governments create a wealth tax where it did not exist, as in Mexico
source_title: A Slim, Salinas Pliego, Larrea y otros les une que hacen todo para evitar el SAT
grading_note: The report directly names Nuestro Presupuesto as joining the Mexican campaign to demand creation of a wealth tax. Grade B campaign evidence.
